law_name: Act on Protection of Personal Information (APPI)
deceased_data: Not covered: personal information is information relating to a living individual (art. 2(1))
research_exemption: Since 2022 amendment (effective 1 Apr 2022) academic research institutions get per-obligation exceptions instead of a blanket exemption
genetic_data: Genomic data can be personal information (individual identification code, art. 2(2)); not confirmed as special care-required (art. 2(3)) (unconfirmed)
notes: 2026 amendment adds administrative fines; effective date by cabinet order (<=2 yrs)
pending_change: Amendment Act No. 56 of 2026 (administrative fines) promulgated 17 Jul 2026; not yet in force
